facts.summary: FDA meeting requires new Phase 3 after missed primary endpoint · Phase 3 · efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Company to continue development of efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis incorporating FDA feedback; Company to pursue with new Phase 3 study (C-006)
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: EFZO-FIT missed its primary endpoint but demonstrated a safety profile consistent with previous trials and durable benefit on multiple clinically meaningful, prespecified quality of life measures
evidence.safety: EFZO-FIT missed its primary endpoint but demonstrated a safety profile consistent with previous trials
evidence.program_discontinued: Company to continue development of efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis incorporating FDA feedback
